subject: CAIQ: telemetry & tenant-residency evidence stitching
messages:
From: Jordan Smith <j.smith@nordichealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nordic Health Security Team <sec@nordichealth.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2025 14:12:00 +0200
Subject: CAIQ telemetry & tenant residency - evidence ask

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. As we prepare our CSA CAIQ submission we need a compact evidence package for these two areas:

1) Telemetry: what runtime telemetry you retain (ingestion logs, inference traces, token-level latency metrics), retention windows, and an example log snippet showing an anonymized inference trace.
2) Tenant residency / isolation: mapping that demonstrates how tenant-bound logs are separated (KV-cache tenancy, tenant IDs in traces, S3 buckets or project separation).

Can you provide a CAIQ mapping table (CSV/PDF) with the specific control IDs your artifacts map to, a short narrative for each, and at least one representative artifact per control? We are aiming to include these in our internal audit pack next week.

Ideal timeline: deliver a draft by Monday Aug 4, and final by Aug 8. Let me know if that schedule works.

Cheers,
Jordan
Jordan Smith
Security Engineer, Nordic Health
j.smith@nordichealth.com
+44 20 7123 4567

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <j.smith@nordichealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2025 16:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: CAIQ telemetry & tenant residency - evidence ask

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver a scoped bundle that covers both telemetry and residency with a CAIQ control crosswalk. Quick notes:

- We will provide a mapping PDF and the CSV crosswalk (control -> artifact -> owner).
- Representative artifacts: anonymized inference trace (kvcache pointer redacted), sample audit log showing request-id, tenant-id, timestamp, and reduced token-level latency; and the S3/project manifest showing tenant-segregated storage prefixes.
- Owners: Kimberly will assemble the telemetry artifacts and retention statements; Markus will provide the storage/residency manifests and keystore notes.

I can get a draft to you by Monday EOD (Aug 4). Attaching a short draft mapping (redwood_caiq_telemetry_map_v0.3.pdf) and a tiny sample log (kvcache_log_sample.txt) for immediate review.

On timeline: Aug 8 final is fine if we get feedback early in the week.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_caiq_telemetry_map_v0.3.pdf (PDF, 312 KB)
Attachment: kvcache_log_sample.txt (TXT, 4 KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 2 Aug 2025 09:22:00 +0200
Subject: Re: CAIQ telemetry & tenant residency - evidence ask

Irene / Markus — quick coordination notes from infra: 

- Telemetry retention: application request logs (api-gateway) retained 90 days; inference runtime traces and token-latency aggregates retained 30 days; aggregated time-series retained 1 year (used for perf baselining). We will include the retention policy excerpt from our Logging Playbook.
- Anonymized trace: kvcache_log_sample.txt demonstrates a sanitized trace; keys and tenant IDs are masked with TID-REDACTED and trace ids are UUIDs.
- Residency proof: Markus, can you export the storage manifest for the EU region (project redwood-prod-eu) showing tenant prefixes? Ensure the manifest hides PII and includes ACL snapshots.
- For the CAIQ mapping: I will tag each artifact with control IDs (e.g., CCS_TD-01 -> inference traces, CCS_RS-03 -> storage segregation) in the CSV.

Action items:
- Kimberly: compile telemetry retention statement + logging playbook excerpt (by Sun Aug 3 EOD).
- Markus: export EU storage manifest + ACL snapshot (by Sun Aug 3 EOD).
- Irene: stitch mapping and produce PDF draft (Mon Aug 4).

If we hit any blockers I will raise an ops ticket but looks straightforward.

-kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Observability & Platform Security
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 11:30:00 +0200
Subject: Re: CAIQ telemetry & tenant residency - evidence ask

Thanks — attaching the manifest export and ACL snapshot to the drive link (see JIRA SECOPS-4821 for access). Notes:

- The manifest is a CSV with columns: bucket, prefix, region, created_at, acl_snapshot_ref. Prefixes follow tenant/<tenant-hash>/ and are segregated by project: redwood-prod-eu-logs vs redwood-prod-eu-artifacts.
- Keystore / encryption: the manifest includes a reference to KMS key aliases (no key material). For CAIQ evidence we will include a short statement about KMS usage and key rotation cadence.
- I limited the export to buckets that contain telemetry or audit logs to keep the package small.

Attachment posted: caiq_claims_index.xlsx (Drive folder)

-markus
Markus Klein
Principal Cloud Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <j.smith@nordichealth.com>
Cc: Nordic Health Security Team <sec@nordichealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 17:48:00 +0200
Subject: CAIQ telemetry & tenant residency - draft package (attached)

Jordan — attached is our draft CAIQ mapping and a small artifact bundle for your review. Highlights: 

- redwood_caiq_telemetry_map_v0.3.pdf: control-by-control mapping and short narratives for each artifact. Covers telemetry controls (CCM-AUD-01, CCM-LOG-02, CCM-MON-05) and residency controls (CCM-IS-01, CCM-DS-03).
- kvcache_log_sample.txt: sanitized inference trace with tenant identifiers redacted; shows request-id, anonymized tenant token (TID-REDACTED), timestamps, and per-token latency summary.
- caiq_claims_index.xlsx: CSV/Excel crosswalk (control -> artifact -> owner -> retention window -> link). The drive folder contains the manifest and ACL snapshot referenced in the mapping.

Requested next steps: please review the mapping and indicate if any control needs additional context or a different artifact. If everything looks good we will finalize and produce a PDF-ready pack for your audit team by Aug 8.

Link to drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aZk-ExampleDriveLink 
JIRA: SECOPS-4821 (includes manifest export and ACL snapshot)

Thanks,
Irene

Attachment: redwood_caiq_telemetry_map_v0.3.pdf, caiq_claims_index.xlsx

From: Jordan Smith <j.smith@nordichealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nordic Health Security Team <sec@nordichealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 18:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: CAIQ telemetry & tenant residency - draft package (attached)

Irene — Received, thanks. Quick skim looks great; we'll validate with our auditor on Tues and get back with any gaps. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Jordan
